purpose: Fixed Near You routes the scheduled geography-navigation field-vitals probe visits at both binding viewports. Every observation is stamped traffic_class=synthetic so the synthetic measurement group never mixes with resident production traffic.
selection_rationale: Geography-navigation release proof binds desktop and mobile viewports used by the capture harness (1440 and 390). The probe visits /near-you (and / after default-local-home for home-surface classification notes only when listed). Popularity is not a selection input.
maintenance: Replace unreachable paths by reviewed edit. The probe reports unreachable pages per slot instead of substituting its own.

device_profiles.rationale: Binding desktop viewport used by geography-navigation release captures.
Binding mobile viewport used by geography-navigation release captures.

network_profile.rationale: Fixed throttle so distribution changes track the deployed surface.

interaction.purpose: INP requires a real interaction; load-and-idle leaves the INP cell unclosable forever.

visit_policy.rationale: One cold visit per path per viewport per slot, then one driven interaction so LCP/CLS and INP can all retain observations.

pages.rationale: Canonical Near You document path for geography-navigation field vitals.
